name: [FinOps][Protective] Azure OpenAI retry storm - billable failed requests

esqlQuery.esql: FROM logs-azure_openai.* | WHERE azure.resource.name IS NOT NULL | STATS total = COUNT(*), errors = COUNT(CASE(http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, null)) BY azure.resource.name | EVAL error_rate = TO_DOUBLE(errors) / TO_DOUBLE(total) * 100 | WHERE total > 100 AND error_rate > 20 | SORT error_rate DESC
